name: LRT Jakarta official network publication
access_notes: The official Jakarta transport authority publication dated 2026-09-25 confirms current limited operation: Kelapa Gading–Manggarai 05:30–20:00 at 15-minute headway, then Kelapa Gading–Velodrome 20:01–23:00. LRT Jakarta robots rules disallow automated retrieval, so operator-site crawling is not used. A local frequency-derived research representation is validated without claiming exact departures.
redistribution_rule: The official privacy/copyright page reserves rights; no open-data or redistribution permission was found.
freshness: Official current limited-operation facts were published on 2026-09-25 and reviewed on 2026-10-01; stable machine access is not available.
